manifest.title: Zammad Helpdesk
manifest.author: Zammad Foundation
manifest.description:
Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI assistant by Nous Research. It features a built-in learning loop that creates and refines skills, searches past conversations, and builds user profiles across sessions.

**Key Features:**
- Multi-platform messaging: Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, Matrix, Email, and more
- OpenAI-compatible API server for integration with Open WebUI, LobeChat, LibreChat, etc.
- Flexible LLM support: OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI/Grok, and custom endpoints
- Procedural memory with autonomous skill creation
- Built-in cron scheduler for unattended tasks
- Parallel subagent processing
- Optional Nextcloud/WebDAV sync, Tailscale private networking, Bitwarden CLI, Cloudron CLI, local browser vision, xAI X search, Perplexity, and Vane search support in the Cloudron package
manifest.tagline: Self-improving AI agent with multi-platform messaging gateway
manifest.changelog: * Initial release of Zammad for Cloudron (test with Hermes payload)
